 Order
The petitioner-accused No.1 is before this Court seeking grant of anticipatory bail in Crime
No.22/2024 of Kolar Women Police Station, pending on the file of the learned Iii Addl.Civil Judge
and Jmfc,

Kolar registered for the offences punishable under Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and Sections 506, 498A, 504, 307, 323, 354 R/w Section 34 of Indian Penal Code (for short 'IPC'), on the basis of the first information lodged by the informant Shashikala.
2. Heard Sri. Nanjunda Gowda, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri.Rahul Rai K, learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent-State.
Perused the materials on record.

3. In view of the rival contentions urged by the learned counsel for both the parties, the point that would arise for my consideration is:
"Whether the petitioner is entitled for grant of bail under Section 438 of Cr.P.C.?"
NC: 2024:KHC:20164 My answer to the above point is in 'Affirmative' for the following:
REASONS 4. Petitioner being accused No.1 is seeking anticipatory bail.
Wife of the petitioner lodged the first information for the aforesaid offences.
It is stated that accused Nos.2 to 5, who are the relatives of this petitioner were granted anticipatory bail.
As per the first information, marriage with the first informant with the petitioner was held on 03.05.2023 and only for a short period of time, both have led marital life.
The incident alleged was occurred on 31.07.2023.
On the basis of the first information lodged by the wife, a case was registered in NCR No. 17/2023 and the couples were referred to the mediation.
Since the efforts made in the mediation failed, first information came to be lodged by the wife.
Accordingly, FIR was came to be registered on 06.03.2024.
Even though, it is stated that the petitioner had assaulted her and tried to hang her, no prima-facie materials are placed before this Court to show that she had sustained any injuries.

Looking to all these facts and circumstances, I am of the opinion that the petitioner NC: 2024:KHC:20164 may be granted anticipatory bail subject to conditions, which will take care of the apprehensions expressed by the learned High Court Government Pleader that the petitioner may abscond or may tamper or threaten the prosecution witnesses.

5. Accordingly, I answer the above point in the affirmative and proceed to pass the following:
ORDER
The petition is allowed.
The petitioner is ordered to be enlarged on bail in the event of his arrest in Crime No.22/2024 of Kolar Women Police Station.
